notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Hornet Nest indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Hornet Nest.
description:
Give Hornet Nest indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Hornet Nest.
Hornet Nest triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing the Insect to deal one damage to Hornet Nest.
Repeat from step 3.
